title: Nuthana Vatsaramu – David Raju Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: దోషమె రాశిగ నిలచిన – యేసుని హస్తము కాచెను
నూతన ఆత్మతో పాడుము – నిత్యము క్రీస్తుని వేడుము
english: 1. Aasala padhiri kuulina – mosapu uubiloo chikkina
dhooshame raasiga nilachina – yeasuni hastamu kaachenu
nuuthana aathmathoo paadumu – nithyamu kriisthuni veadumu
intro: Nuthana Vatsaramu is the latest Christian Telugu song written by Bishop Pammi Daniel, sung by Dinesh, Tushara, music composed by Sudhakar Rella and produced by Ps David Raju K. This song was released on December 26, 2023 through Divya David YouTube channel.
